about: HPOP against ERFA and NAIF SPICE: clock, Earth orientation, TEME axes, Sun and Moon at the 50 hourly sample epochs of the reference cases (run-erfa-spice.mjs). Largest value over the epochs.

rows.quantity: TAI - UTC
rows.reference: ERFA eraDat; SPICE naif0012.tls
rows.note: 37 s at every epoch on all three

rows.quantity: TT from UTC
rows.reference: ERFA eraUtctai + eraTaitt (two-part)
rows.note: HPOP carries TT as whole seconds and their fraction

rows.quantity: TDB - TT
rows.reference: ERFA eraDtdb (geocentre)
rows.note: HPOP: 1.658 ms sin M + 14 us sin 2M, the difference taken in one double Julian date (40 us steps)

rows.quantity: TDB - TT
rows.reference: SPICE (deltet: its two-term formula), against ERFA
rows.note: reference spread

rows.quantity: TDB date the force model receives
rows.reference: ERFA TT + eraDtdb
rows.note: one double Julian date (resolution 40 us) of HPOP's TDB

rows.quantity: GCRF -> ITRF at HPOP's own instant
rows.reference: ERFA, IERS 2010 CIO chain, full X/Y/s series at that instant
rows.note: HPOP interpolates X, Y and s linearly between whole hours of TT (stated bound 0.02 mas)

rows.quantity: GCRF -> ITRF at the UTC epoch
rows.reference: ERFA, the same chain at the exact epoch
rows.note: adds the force model's clock: Earth rotation at the single-double TDB date and HPOP's TDB - TT

rows.quantity: ERFA at HPOP's instant against ERFA at the epoch
rows.reference: ERFA
rows.note: the clock alone (Earth rotation over the instant difference)

rows.quantity: GCRF -> ITRF
rows.reference: SPICE J2000 -> ITRF93 (earth_latest_high_prec.bpc)
rows.note: independent chain: IAU 1976/1980 with the BPC's own EOP and nutation corrections, J2000 taken as ICRF

rows.quantity: GCRF -> ITRF, reference spread
rows.reference: SPICE ITRF93 against ERFA at the epoch
rows.note: reference spread

rows.quantity: GMST of the tides (gmst2006) at HPOP's own UT1 and TT
rows.reference: ERFA eraGmst06 at the same dates
rows.note: HPOP's own ERA + IAU 2006 polynomial (not ERFA)

rows.quantity: GMST of the tides at the UTC epoch
rows.reference: ERFA eraGmst06 at the exact UT1 and TT
rows.note: adds the single-double UT1 and TT dates

rows.quantity: GCRF -> Earth-fixed without Earth orientation input
rows.reference: ERFA, IERS 2010 chain with the case rows
rows.note: HPOP's fallback when no EOP is supplied: IAU 1976/1980, GAST at UTC, no polar motion, no frame bias, as documented (force_models.h); the pole part is the omitted polar motion, the spin part UT1 - UTC. A PRW request with an Earth-fixed force is refused without EOP (eop-data-required), so no reference case reaches it

rows.quantity: IAU 1976 precession (lib/coords precession)
rows.reference: ERFA eraPmat76 at the same TT
rows.note: stated "as ERFA pmat76"

rows.quantity: IAU 1980 nutation (lib/coords nutationMatrix)
rows.reference: ERFA eraNutm80 at the same TT
rows.note: HPOP keeps 63 of the 106 terms (each omitted term under 0.3 mas)

rows.quantity: GCRF -> TEME (lib/coords gcrfToTeme)
rows.reference: ERFA eraPnm80, eraEqeq94 at the same TT
rows.note: the plugin's coords::transform TEME axes

rows.quantity: GCRF -> Earth-fixed without Earth orientation input
rows.reference: ERFA eraGmst82 + eraEqeq94, eraNutm80, eraPmat76 (UT1 = UTC, no polar motion) at the same instant
rows.note: the chain the fallback states it implements

rows.quantity: GCRF -> TEME (SGP4 axes)
rows.reference: ERFA eraPnm06a, eraEe06a at the exact epoch
rows.note: the definition propagator/sgp4 uses

rows.quantity: GCRF -> TEME (SGP4 axes)
rows.reference: ERFA eraPnm80, eraEqeq94 (the FK5 definition)
rows.note: spread between the two published TEME definitions

rows.quantity: Sun relative to the Earth, at HPOP's TDB date
rows.reference: SPICE spkgeo, the same DE440 file and date
rows.note: kernel reading and interpolation

rows.quantity: Sun relative to the Earth, at the UTC epoch
rows.reference: SPICE spkgeo at TDB = ERFA TT + eraDtdb
rows.note: adds HPOP's TDB clock

rows.quantity: Moon relative to the Earth, at HPOP's TDB date
rows.reference: SPICE spkgeo, the same DE440 file and date
rows.note: kernel reading and interpolation

rows.quantity: Moon relative to the Earth, at the UTC epoch
rows.reference: SPICE spkgeo at TDB = ERFA TT + eraDtdb
rows.note: adds HPOP's TDB clock
